messages.author: cb3ac8a53ecf9e77
messages.subject: Reactive server problem
parts:
Hello--

I'm having trouble with the updateSelectizeInput function within a reactive environment on a server.  However, running the following code locally (via Run App) works fine.  In short, I want the user to select a file, then have the column names available for the user to select one of them as the response.  When running the code locally, the UIRESPONSE value gets updated with the column names of the selected data set.  However, when running on a server, the UIRESPONSE does not get updated and stays as "Response."

Any help would be appreciated.  Thanks,
--Kjell

Here is the server.R syntax:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  shinyFileChoose(input, 'UIDATAFILE', roots=getVolumes(), session=session, restrictions=system.file(package='base'))
  
  tmpData=reactive({
    if(is.null(input$UIDATAFILE)) return()
    isolate({        
        tmpData = read.csv(file.path({parseFilePaths(getVolumes()(), input$UIDATAFILE)}$datapath[1]))
        updateSelectizeInput(session, "UIRESPONSE", choices=names(tmpData))
      })
      return(tmpData)
})

  output$PROGPAGE <- renderPrint({    
    if(is.null(input$UIDATAFILE)) return()
    isolate({
      summary(tmpData())
    })
  })

})

And here is the ui.R syntax:
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel('One-way ANOVA'),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      
      helpText(h4("Reactive Server Problem Illustration")),
      tags$hr(),
  
      shinyFilesButton('UIDATAFILE', 'Select CSV data file', 'Please select the data file', FALSE),
      tags$hr(),
      
      selectizeInput('UIRESPONSE', label = h5("Response"),choices = "Response"),
      tags$hr(),
      
      width = 4
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Progress Page",  verbatimTextOutput('PROGPAGE'))
    )
  )
)))

messages.subject: Re: Reactive server problem
parts:
As a rule, never call updateSelectizeInput() (or any updateXXXInput function, or any other side-effecty function) from inside of reactive(); instead, use observe().

  tmpData=reactive({
    validate(need(input$UIDATAFILE, FALSE))

})

  observe({
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "UIRESPONSE", choices=names(tmpData()))
  })

  output$PROGPAGE <- renderPrint({    
    summary(tmpData())
  })

messages.subject: Re: Reactive server problem
parts:
Hello Joe--

Thanks for the guidance on the use of observe() with updateXXXInput functions.  I tried the code you sent and added the following line between the output$PROGPAGE and summary lines to avoid an Error message in the main panel:

validate(need(input$UIDATAFILE, FALSE))

With this modification, the code worked fine when I tried it via Run App on my local machine.  However, when I tried it on the server, I got the message, "The application unexpectedly exited.  Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console"  and the web interface dies.

Any idea why this doesn't work on the server?

Thanks very much,
--Kjell
